title: A Storm in the Town
text:
Last summer, a big storm came to our small town. The wind was very strong, and the rain fell for many hours. Some trees fell down and the roads were full of water. Everybody stayed inside their houses.

The next morning, the sun came out and the people went outside. They cleaned the streets and helped their neighbours. The town was quiet and sad, but the people were happy to work together.

questions.text: How long did the rain fall?
options: It did not rain at all

questions.text: What did the people do the next morning?
options: They cleaned the streets and helped their neighbours

questions.text: How did the storm probably affect the town?
options: It had no effect at all
It moved the town to another place

questions.text: What can we infer about the people in the town?
options: They are selfish and do not help others
They are kind and work well together
They do not like their neighbours
They wanted to leave the town forever

vocabulary.definition: a very strong wind with heavy rain

paragraph_translations: Zeszłego lata duża burza nadeszła do naszego małego miasteczka. Wiatr był bardzo silny, a deszcz padał przez wiele godzin. Niektóre drzewa się przewróciły, a ulice były pełne wody. Wszyscy zostali w swoich domach.
Następnego ranka wyszło słońce i ludzie wyszli na zewnątrz. Sprzątali ulice i pomagali sąsiadom. Miasto było ciche i smutne, ale ludzie cieszyli się, że mogą razem pracować.
